title: #54 - That'S Enough
content:
#54 - That'S Enough

Chapter 54 It’s almost done

Arthur turned around and saw that it was the tavern couple who had escorted their daughter out. They seemed ready to force her head down and make her apologize to the drunken noble.

"Look at your... face, it's your honor to let me touch it."

The drunk nobleman couldn't hold his tongue straight in his mouth, but his hands moved very flexibly, reaching directly to the little girl's shoulders.

He even slowly touched it down to his chest.

The companions of the drunken nobleman also shouted and made noises, completely ignoring the little girl's feelings.

The tavern couple saw this action and pretended not to notice. They just held their daughter's head and asked her to apologize to the "angry" noble.

Some of the surrounding customers pretended not to notice what was going on and just ate their own food. Some of them were cheering, as if they were watching a performance.

Although the little girl's head was held down and her body was assaulted, she still refused to give in and spoke indistinctly through gritted teeth.

Although Arthur felt that this scene was inconsistent with his own values, after all, he was not his own subject, and he had no obligation to care about it.

It was King Robert who had to deal with this, but apparently the king was spending his evenings with the female workers at the Red Keep or some technical academy.

"Master, please forgive us for the fact that she has bowed her head and admitted her mistake. We will add two more barrels of steamed rice wine as an apology." The tavern owner said with an extremely humble attitude.

"No, no, no. I have to let her stay with me all night, all night." The drunken noble raised his index finger in front of the tavern owner.

The boss looked at his daughter and felt a struggle coming from her neck, but he did not dare to stand up for her.

A woman's chastity is not a precious thing, and the old prime minister, Lord Arryn, is still married to a loser, Lysa. He comforted himself like this.

Although according to convention, the golden dragon used to open up new land is definitely not in hand, it is still a good choice if this disaster can be avoided.

The tavern owner nodded, "Just one night then."

Then he relaxed his grip, allowing his daughter to raise her head.

"I don't agree. I didn't do anything wrong. Why are my parents apologizing and asking me to..." The little girl's words were obviously crying, and she burst into tears at the end of the sentence.

When the drunken noble saw this, he became even more excited and hugged the little girl on the spot. It seemed that he couldn't bear it anymore.

"Let me go, I..." The little girl bit the drunken noble's arm hard, and then flexibly escaped.

She stumbled all the way and fell down next to Arthur's table. After climbing several times and unable to get up, she cried even louder.

"Seven Gods, someone come and save me, save this poor man like me."

The drunken noble heard the little girl crying and shouted, and he staggered over.

"I asked you to run, you are mine, you...can you escape?"

He staggered to the little girl's side, smiled extremely obscenely, and then unbuckled his trousers.

Although his pants were still hanging, it was obvious that this could not stop him from acting like an animal.

The little girl was crying. She couldn't count on her parents, and the golden robe that protected them was assigned to the nobles. Her beautiful life had just begun, but it was interrupted by this sudden conflict.

The drunken noble stretched out his paw towards the little girl, ready to start his "wonderful" enjoyment.

But a hand, like the hardest iron, reached out at the right moment and tightly held his claws.

"That's almost it, ah!" Arthur raised his head at him and said coldly.

The drunken nobleman was delirious, but animalistic desires drove him to react.

He tried his best to pull his right hand out of Arthur's hand, but he couldn't get it out.

So he ordered: "Hit him... hit him."

Several of his followers rushed over.

"Where do these country folk come from? Do they know who we are and dare to mess with my lord?"

"Let go of my master, or you won't be able to reap the benefits."

"You are the only one who is worthy of being in contact with my young master's noble body? Why don't you let him go quickly and kneel down to apologize!"

Arthur forced the half-eaten fat pigeon into the drunken noble's mouth, "I'll let you sober up first."

Seeing this, the followers of the drunken noble became more aggressive and came directly to beat Arthur, thinking that this would make Arthur let go of their master.

The surrounding customers who had been afraid to speak before were very active now.

Some verbally scolded Arthur for his behavior, some advised Arthur to let go and not confront the drunken nobles, and some directly fanned the flames and shouted loudly to start a fight.

Desmond was older and more mature, so he persuaded in a low voice: "Let's let it go. It's better to do less than to do more."

Patrick was young, but he supported Arthur's actions, "Yes, that's it, let him go and kill his followers with both hands."

Arthur is not an easy person to deal with, and one hand is enough.

The five followers who rushed to the front received a just kick from Arthur.

This hateful and pitiful man flew back faster than when he came. Like floating catkins, he hit the wall hard, paused, and then slowly fell to the ground.

His chest was still rising and falling, and he seemed to be alive, but only alive.

The second person didn't have time to react, and suffered a big fight from Arthur. He flew a few steps off the ground and fell to the ground. Half of his face immediately swelled up and he screamed repeatedly.

The third and fourth ones also received a kick and a slap, but because Arthur did not have enough energy, they suffered much less.

The fifth follower was much smarter. Seeing this situation, he pretended to be a passerby and slipped away from another table.

"Stop fighting, sirs, please stop fighting. We just need to accompany our daughter. Stop fighting." The tavern couple begged, but in their words, their daughter was an unimportant thing that could be abandoned.

The customers in the tavern had different reactions as before.

Some people advocated giving him face and releasing the drunk nobleman, some people cheered for Arthur's actions, and some people threatened Arthur and wanted Arthur to receive the punishment he deserved.

Arthur glanced at them coldly and shouted: "Shut up."

The customers were concerned about Arthur's strength and stopped talking. The tavern suddenly became quiet.

Then, he looked at the drunk noble: "Are you sober? Do you know that this is King's Landing, not your little territory?"

The drunk noble's eyes were clearer at this time, and after reacting, his attitude became more fierce.

"Where did you come from, you little country noble, and you dare to stop me from doing good things? Let go, or I'll break your dog's paw."

"Her parents have agreed to let her spend the night with me, why are you pretending to be a good person here?"

The little girl sobbed softly, and when Arthur stood up for her, she said intermittently: "Thank you, thank you... Master."

Arthur ignored the drunk noble's barking and asked the poor little girl: "What is your attitude?"

He stood up for this little girl, if she gave in, he would let go and leave it alone.

"It was him who touched me first, why do you want me to apologize? I don't want to spend the night with him, not at all!" The little girl's attitude was very firm.

Arthur nodded, "Okay, I know."

Then he turned and stared at the drunk noble, saying word by word: "I've said it all, that's enough, you don't understand, right?"
